crossRefs.note: She said, “He gave me these six measures of barley; for he said, ‘Don’t go empty to your mother-in-law.’ ”

translations.web: She said, “He gave me these six measures of barley; for he said, ‘Don’t go empty to your mother-in-law.’ ”
translations.bsb: And she said, “He gave me these six measures of barley, for he said, ‘Do not go back to your mother-in-law empty-handed.’”
translations.kjv: And she said, These six measures of barley gave he me; for he said to me, Go not empty unto thy mother in law.
translations.asv: And she said, These six measures of barley gave he me; for he said, Go not empty unto thy mother-in-law.
